requirements.title: First-Video YouTube Thumbnail
requirements.definition: Creation of a usable thumbnail for the nonprofit organization's first YouTube video based on the supplied video, reference thumbnail, ideas, and design guidance.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested thumbnail artifact itself. The source of the subject photograph and restrictions on AI-assisted production can be changed or assessed independently and are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Use Video Screenshots for Subject Image
requirements.definition: Use an image of the client extracted from the supplied video for this thumbnail rather than requiring a separately taken headshot.
requirements.boundary_note: The selected source for the subject image can be revised or replaced independently of the overall thumbnail design and AI-use policy.

requirements.title: Restricted AI Use in Thumbnail Production
requirements.definition: Produce the thumbnail without AI-generated assets or wholesale AI alteration of photographs, while permitting only minimal Photoshop Generative Fill touch-ups such as removing a distracting background prop.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats prohibited AI-generated assets, prohibited coarse whole-photo edits, disallowed external AI-upload workflows, and the narrow Generative Fill exception as attributes of one tightly coupled production policy.

unresolved_candidates.description: The three proposed video titles are clearly supplied as A/B-test context, but the evidence does not establish whether title-variation work or title-specific thumbnail variants are independently required deliverables.
